runs.pass_label: Pass 1: Primary Dataset, Verbatim Price & Melt Arithmetic Verification

checks.name: Official HTTPS Source Allowlist & Row Link Completeness
checks.details: Verified 61 HTTPS source links across 21 rings, 5 sellers, 7 karat standards, and 2 live spot feeds against strict official domain allowlist.

checks.name: Verbatim Price & Gram-Weight Substring Proof (Anti-Hallucination Check)
checks.details: Confirmed all 21 prices and all 8 published gram weights appear verbatim inside archived 2026-10-22 primary listing excerpts.

checks.name: Zero-Inference Enforcement (Unverified Values Strictly Left Blank/Null)
checks.details: Confirmed 14 items with unconfirmed metal gram weights or mixed-karat splits keep null numeric cells (never inferred) and carry explicit review flags.

checks.name: NIST Troy-Ounce (31.1034768 g) & Raw Melt Arithmetic Audit
checks.details: Mathematically verified spot conversion ($4,025.10 / 31.1034768 = $129.4100/g), all 7 karat tiers, and all 7 weight-complete rings to <= $0.02 tolerance.

checks.name: Automated Irregularity, Plated-Control, BBB & Return-Exclusion Scanner
checks.details: Cataloged 37 line-by-line review flags across 17 flagged ring entries for publication on flagged-for-review.html.

runs.manual_review_recommendation: Always run scripts/run_security_audit.py after every review or edit, and inspect flagged-for-review.html directly against linked primary product pages to look for price changes, copy discrepancies, or hallucinations.
